_note: DQ-T60 — the LIVE proof that removing `_meta.paid` lets the tool reach its own confirm card. composition_library_translate declared paid=True while pricing arithmetically, so chat-service's spend gate SUSPENDED every well-formed call before the estimate existed: 15 calls, 12 suspended, 0 ever ok, against a sibling of identical shape (translation_start_job) at 80 of 82 ok. The flag is removed; this batch asks whether the call now EXECUTES. 🔴 NOTHING SPENDS: the tool only mints a token, `approve` is null so no card is ever accepted, and the fixture is a motif this scenario creates for itself.

scenarios.prompt: Translate my motif {step:0:id} into Vietnamese using model 019ebb72-27a2-72f3-a42d-d2d0e0ded179.
scenarios.prompt_source: 🔴 THE IDS ARE HANDED OVER DELIBERATELY, and the reason is that they are NOT what is under test. `_LibraryTranslateArgs` requires BOTH `ids` and `model_ref`, and `model_ref` has no supplier on this tool's own surface — which is why 3 of the 15 historical calls died on missing arguments before ever reaching a gate. Supplying them makes the trigger deterministic so the measurement is about the SPEND GATE and nothing else. The same route the degenerate-UUID and placeholder arms were proven by.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM motif WHERE code='throwaway-paidgate-c60-{run_id}' AND status <> 'archived'
seed_assert.why: 🔴 THE SAFETY FIXTURE, copied from batch 19's reasoning. Motifs are ACCOUNT-scoped — there is no throwaway BOOK that contains the damage — and the caller owns ~150 real ones. So the scenario creates its OWN motif under a unique code and names only that one. The `{run_id}` nonce is load-bearing: batch 20 lost 4 of 5 runs to a FIXED code, because an account-scoped seed collides with itself on repeat.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF the call is SUSPENDED on a platform spend card (a pending tool_call record) — that is the pre-fix behaviour, and it means `_meta.paid` is still being read somewhere. PASSES IF the call EXECUTES and returns a confirm_token together with an estimate: the tool reached its own card, which is the one that can state the price. 🔴 A RUN THAT DIES ON MISSING ARGUMENTS IS A THIRD OUTCOME AND MUST BE READ AS NEITHER — it never reached the gate, and it is a known separate defect of this tool's surface (`model_ref` required with no supplier).

answer_expect.why: None. The measurement is the recorded tool_call — whether it carries `pending: true` or a result with a confirm_token — not the reply text.

ship_audit.gate: OWED and PRESERVED — Tier W is unchanged; the confirm token IS the gate, and this batch is checking it can be reached at all.
ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a motif id that is not the caller's must be refused (the tool returns a uniform non-enumerating refusal).
ship_audit.idempotency: OWED — proposing twice must mint two tokens and spend nothing.
ship_audit.tenancy: Account-scoped; the scenario creates its own motif under a run-nonced code and never approves the card.
